title: passiflora citrifolia
intro: Passiflora citrifolia, commonly known as yellow granadilla, is a species of passionflower native to Central and South America. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce anxiety and insomnia, as well as alleviate symptoms of menopause and menstrual disorders. The therapeutic actions of Passiflora citrifolia include sedative, anxiolytic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive compounds in this plant are responsible for its therapeutic effects and contribute to its traditional use as a calming agent and natural remedy for various health issues.
